g.text: UML Diagram: Class TextMapping in Context
- The arrows of the inheritance tree are

a.title: • LabelForDisplay: A structured display label. Label provides display content of a fully human readable display for the identification of the object.
a.xlink:title: • LabelForDisplay: A structured display label. Label provides display content of a fully human readable display for the identification of the object.

a.title: • PhysicalMapping: Physical characteristics of the values of an instance variable as part of a physical data set.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalMapping: Physical characteristics of the values of an instance variable as part of a physical data set.

a.title: • ControlledVocabularyEntry: Allows for unstructured content which may be an entry from an externally maintained controlled vocabulary.If the content is from a controlled vocabulary provide the code value of the entry, as well as a reference to the controlled vocabulary from which the value is taken. a.title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.
a.xlink:title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

a.title: • PhysicalDataSet: Information needed for understanding the physical structure of data coming from a file or other source.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalDataSet: Information needed for understanding the physical structure of data coming from a file or other source.

a.title: • PhysicalMappingPosition: Denotes the position of a physical mapping in a sequence within a physical data set.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalMappingPosition: Denotes the position of a physical mapping in a sequence within a physical data set.

a.title: • InstanceVariable: Use of a represented variable within a data set.
a.xlink:title: • InstanceVariable: Use of a represented variable within a data set.

a.title: • indexes: Assigns a position to a value mapping within a physical segment.
a.xlink:title: • indexes: Assigns a position to a value mapping within a physical segment.
